name: Sunday & Sugar
policy_text:
[P1] Order details
Each order needs a catalog product, positive whole-number quantity, pickup date, and pickup time. Missing details must be clarified.

[P2] Pickup and lead time
Use the configured pickup window and minimum lead time. Do not promise a pickup outside these rules.

[P3] Capacity
Daily production capacity is a limit for each product and date. Existing approved orders reserve capacity. Pending requests do not reserve capacity.

[P4] Substitutions
An alternative product may be offered only if capacity permits. The customer must explicitly agree before changing products.

[P5] Approval and changes
A draft response is not an order confirmation. The owner approves orders after a fresh capacity check. A change to an approved order keeps its original reservation until the owner approves the replacement.

[P6] Cancellation
Cancellation of an approved order requires owner review. Release reserved capacity only when the cancellation is recorded.
